reason: Slack leg of the provider-neutral terminal notice: when the lifecycle terminal edit carries the structured view, render it with slackJobNotificationBlocks on chat.update/postMessage instead of markdown text; text stays as the fallback field; API rejection falls back to text. Scope: slack progress helper, slack channel-delivery.ts, slack message-action-affordances.ts, slack test.

quality.summary: Slack terminal notice is the native block card in the same single message. Lite window Q-0089 (base a9d092fd0 -> HEAD): Slack renders the terminal progress edit with slackJobNotificationBlocks when the structured view is present (same ts when a handle exists, post-once otherwise); fallback only on block-validation errors and it keeps the action-only blocks; terminal dedupe keyed on canonical block JSON, non-terminal dedupe unchanged. Proof: slack suite 196 green, channels suite green, tsc, architecture, verify.py passed. Autoreview 3 rounds: 3 findings accepted+fixed, 1 rejected (TypeScript build claim — tsc clean at HEAD), final clean. Note: the companion job for the first pass hung after finishing its edits (log silent 51 min at 'Running focused TypeScript tests'); the tree it produced was verified independently.
